Theorem
[Banach inverse function theorem (Theorem K.3)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0349, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0350, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0351 ↗ lem:chow-iv-k2-contraction 1. appk:K.3\group Implicit Function Theorem

Let $f:U\subset X\to Y$ be $C^k$ between Banach spaces, $k\ge 1$, and let $Df(x_0)$ be bijective. Then on neighborhoods $W$ of $x_0$ and $f(x_0)$, $f|_W$ is a $C^k$ diffeomorphism. Its inverse satisfies \[ D(f^{-1})(y)=\bigl(Df(f^{-1}(y))\bigr)^{-1}. \]
